description: The multi-account Google Calendar layer for agents that must never surprise a human.

novel_features.name: Conflict verdict engine
novel_features.description: One command answers 'am I double-booked?' across every account, and refuses to give a confident all-clear over partial or stale data.

novel_features.name: Open-slot enumeration
novel_features.description: Ranked open windows of a requested duration across all accounts, computed from live freebusy under the same busy semantics as conflicts.

novel_features.name: Safe-mutation contract
novel_features.description: Writes take an etag precondition and return the pre-image plus a structured inverse operation, so every change is cleanly reversible and race-safe.

novel_features.name: Stateless change sweep
novel_features.description: Everything that moved, appeared, or was cancelled across all accounts since a caller-held watermark — deletions included.

novel_features.name: Manifest reconciliation
novel_features.description: Diffs live calendar reality across all accounts against the approved calendars.yaml — new, missing, or permission-drifted calendars become findings.

novel_features.name: Recurring-series deviations
novel_features.description: Instances of recurring events that moved or were cancelled in a window — the routine-deviation surprises, isolated.
